page_note: This page contains the major five-faculty cosmological teaching: the beautiful tree with five members (reflection, counsel, teaching, thought, mind) mapped onto cosmic figures (Man of Glory/perfect Man; First Man in ship of night; Third Ambassador in ship of living fire/day; great Mind = God of truth, Mind of all aeons of glory). This is core cosmological-correspondential substrate — domain→domain mapping, internal to the cosmic system. The substrate is interrupted in two places by ecclesial overlays: (1) seg 5-6 identifies the tree's fruits with the Holy Church + her teachers and catechumens; (2) seg 13 inserts "the reflection is the Church" into the faculty map (Church identified as the earthly correlate of the cosmic faculty) — a clear editorial extension of the substrate pattern; (3) seg 21-22 inserts catechumen almsgiving / purification in Church into the soul-ascent sequence. The soul-ascent ladder in segs 23-30 is otherwise pure substrate — souls conveyed upward through reflection→counsel→teaching→thought→mind, each correlated to its cosmic figure. Heavy damage (100%) limits some classifications. The Coptic preserves ⲡⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ (reflection), ⲡⲥⲁⲭⲛⲉ (counsel), ⲧⲥⲃⲱ (teaching), ⲡⲙⲉⲩⲉ (thought), ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ (mind) — the five-faculty enumeration backbone.
